appDescription.message: Custom background layers, changeset comment suggestions, and Overture building outlines for iD.

overtureEnable.message: Show Overture building controls in iD

overtureEnableHelp.message: Enable these controls when you want to inspect and add buildings. A floating tool panel will appear.

overtureDescription.message:
This feature loads a building layer from Overture.
At zoom 18 or higher, click Load area to fetch buildings for the displayed area. Select an outline and press A or click Add (A).
Check every building before saving: generated outlines may be inaccurate. Compare them with other background imagery and OSM data, and correct their shape and position when necessary. Also, the building is created with the generic building=yes tag. If you know the exact building type, specify it in the properties and add any other known tags.
After moving the map, click the button again to load the displayed area.

backgroundDescription.message:
This feature stores additional custom backgrounds beyond the one provided by iD.
Add backgrounds here with a name and a URL template. In iD, open Background settings (layers icon), then Edit custom background (three dots). Select a saved layer from the panel to display it.
Important: use only backgrounds whose terms permit use for OpenStreetMap mapping!

commentDescription.message:
OSMradamus suggests a changeset comment when you are unsure what to write. It analyses your edits and describes the main changes.
When saving in iD, click OSMradamus to generate a comment based on your edits and the current area. Review and edit it before uploading, or replace it if it is unsuitable.

To add new comment rules, fork the repository on GitHub.

commentsInEnglishHelp.message: Always use English for suggested comments, regardless of the browser language.

hashtagHelp.message: If you enter a hashtag, it is automatically added to the dedicated field when you open the save dialog, until you clear it. You can enter it with or without #. Hashtags can be useful for mapping projects.

gridHelp.message: Generate a grid centred on the current map view, with your chosen cell count and size. It is downloaded as GeoJSON and displayed automatically when iD is ready for editing. If custom data is already loaded, you are asked before replacing it. Use the grid to work systematically on one zone at a time or to divide an area between several mappers.

drawDescription.message: The advanced drawing tool makes it easier to create buildings. Click Draw or press 4: place the first point and move the mouse to adjust the square’s size and orientation. Place the second point and move the mouse to resize the rectangle. Confirm with the third click. For attached buildings, use snapping: the first point and the square’s side corners snap to existing building corners and walls.

senseiDescription.message:
Sensei helps you systematically correct your own tagging mistakes. If you have repeatedly used an incorrect tag combination, you can find and correct the affected objects. Extract them with Overpass Turbo, export GeoJSON and import the file into Sensei. Enter the tags to replace and those to set, then click Start review to find the first object. Correct or skip it to move to the next. Check every object carefully before correcting it! Leave the destination empty to remove tags, or both fields empty for manual review.
Save your edits through iD as usual when you choose to upload the changeset.

ockhamDescription.message: Ockham’s razor simplifies overly complex geometries, typically lines made up of many closely spaced points.

ockhamUse.message: Set the tolerance in metres and click Preview or press 5 to see the proposed simplification. Press 0 or click Apply to confirm. Undo discards the preview or undoes the last simplification if it is still the latest operation.

ockhamData.message: Load the object’s complete data before simplifying. Endpoints and nodes with tags, shared nodes and relation-member nodes detected in the loaded graph are preserved. Save your edits through iD as usual when uploading the changeset.
